# pagetitle: "Srivatsan Balaji"

<canvas id="particle-bg"></canvas>

<style>
#particle-bg {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 100%;
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
}
</style>

<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('particle-bg');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let W, H, particles;

function init() {
  W = canvas.width  = window.innerWidth;
  H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  particles = Array.from({ length: 50 }, () => ({
    x: Math.random() * W,
    y: Math.random() * H,
    r: Math.random() * 3 + 1,
    dx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1,
    dy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1,
    alpha: Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.2,
  }));
}

function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(200, 200, 200, ${p.alpha})`;
    ctx.fill();
    p.x += p.dx;
    p.y += p.dy;
    if (p.x < 0 || p.x > W) p.dx *= -1;
    if (p.y < 0 || p.y > H) p.dy *= -1;
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}

window.addEventListener('resize', init);
init();
draw();
</script>

### Hi, I'm Srivatsan!

### This is the place where I share stuff about my research, interests, and life in general.
:::

::: {style="text-align: justify; margin-top: 30px;"}
My goal is to enhance the capabilities of robots by building hardware that overcomes existing physical limitations. By integrating compliant mechanisms, designing torsion-resistant metamaterials, and embedding flexible tactile sensors, I built physical systems that can naturally handle the chaos of the real world. When the hardware is smart, adaptive, and structurally resilient, the software boundary expands.

To achieve this, I use principles of mechanical design, materials, and digital fabrication techniques to overcome the limitations of traditional manufacturing.

I am actively looking for PhD positions in the areas of soft robotics, manipulation, and hardware design.
:::
